propositions: Production rich-text convergence mutates binding entries through shallow all_bindings() without a dedicated mutation seam, bypassing lifecycle policy constraints.
A new narrow operation note_rich_emit(local_id, wire) must own counter/hash behavior and return nonfatal missing-binding results without introducing per-emit saves.
The operation must produce identical hash, counter, and persisted bytes as the legacy sequence when a single pass-level save follows, not from its own save calls.
all_bindings() must remain shallow with unchanged copy depth and facade signatures; the new method becomes the documented supported mutation seam.
No production adapter or reconciler caller must obtain direct writable repository or lifecycle objects through the facade.
